footer.label: Site
footer.tagline: Bots and services, connected in one place.

banner.title: Cookies and statistics
banner.text: EchoPhase uses the cookies it needs to keep you signed in. With your permission it also counts page visits and receives error reports, both without personal data, to see what to improve.

settings.title: Cookie settings
settings.intro: Choose what EchoPhase may collect beyond what it needs to work. You can change this at any time from the page footer.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: Sign-in and request protection cookies, and your theme, language and this choice, kept in your browser. The site does not work without them.

analytics.label: Statistics
analytics.description: Which pages are visited, from which kind of device and country, counted by our own Umami. No cookies, no profile of you, nothing shared.

errors.label: Error reports
errors.description: When something breaks in the page, what broke and where, sent to our own GlitchTip, so it gets fixed. No personal data.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.text: There is nothing at this address. It may have moved, or the link may be mistyped.

maintenance.title: Under maintenance
maintenance.text: EchoPhase is being updated. We will be back shortly.

unavailable.title: Can't reach EchoPhase
unavailable.text: The service is not responding right now.

outage.auto: This page comes back by itself when the service does.

errors.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.http_429: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.http_500: Something went wrong on our side. Try again later.
errors.http_502: The service is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.http_503: The service is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.http_504: The service took too long to answer. Try again later.
errors.Forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.LockedOut: This account is locked for now. Try again later.
errors.InvalidUserName: The username may contain only Latin letters, digits and - . _ @ +
errors.PasswordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
errors.PasswordRequiresDigit: The password must contain a digit (0–9).
errors.PasswordRequiresLower: The password must contain a lowercase letter (a–z).
errors.PasswordRequiresUpper: The password must contain an uppercase letter (A–Z).

errors.UnsupportedType: This kind of file cannot be uploaded here.
errors.InvalidTimeZone: Unknown time zone. Pick one from the list, e.g. Europe/Moscow.
